description: Graphical TSC story authoring for Forest/SevenBridge, highlighting, checking and GSC compilation.
trust: Highlighting works in Restricted Mode. Checking and compilation require a trusted workspace.
path: Full path to the LiarsoftTool command-line program, for example C:\Tools\LiarsoftTool\liarsofttool.exe or /usr/local/bin/liarsofttool.
encoding: GSC text encoding. Choose the encoding used by the target game.
output: Folder for compiled GSC files. Relative paths start from the TSC file’s folder. Leave empty to save there. Existing files with the same name may be overwritten.
